process_area.title: Import Sourcing Performance, Consolidation & Total-Landed-Cost Analytics

value_stream.name: Global Sourcing, Import Buying & Sourcing Agent Management

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Supply Planning (links to VS-02), Buyers (links to VS-01), Freight (links to VS-110), Logistics Finance (links to W3788), DC Ops (links to VS-04)

workflows.name: Import Order Consolidation, Container Planning & Consolidated Buying

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "import container buying" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track container fill-rate / consolidation savings" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-597 (ensure controlled execution — Import Sourcing Performance, Consolidation & Total-Landed-Cost Analytics (PA-122.3).)
- operational: container planning; operational: demand/service-level balance
Pain Points / Risks: - **LCL-excess risk**: Poor consolidation inflates LCL freight cost; mitigated by container planning
- **Over-consolidation risk**: Waiting to fill containers delays availability; mitigated by demand/service-level balance
System Touchpoints: - Supply planning (links to VS-02); import PO (links to VS-02.2); freight (links to VS-110); finance/landed cost (links to VS-17.4); DC (links to VS-04)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/Supply-Planning plan consolidated import container buying: aggregate category/entity demand into container-load POs, sequence vendor POs by origin/port/lead time to fill containers and reduce partial-load (LCL) cost, and balance against demand/lead time (links to VS-02.1)

Global Sourcing/Buyers place consolidated import POs (links to VS-02.2/W2B): multi-vendor/multi-category consolidation at origin, container booking, and origin consolidation-point coordination (agent/office links to W3793/W3794)
Global Sourcing/Freight optimize container utilization (cube/weight) and routing (links to W3803), and track container fill-rate / consolidation savings (links to W3807)

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Freight (links to VS-110), Agent/Office (links to W3793/W3794), Customs (links to VS-87), Quality (links to VS-31), DC Ops (links to VS-04), Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03)

workflows.name: Multi-Vendor / Multi-Category Container & LCL Consolidation Operations

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "execute origin consolidation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-inspect of "inspection of consolidated loads" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile multi-vendor contents at receiving" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-597 (ensure controlled execution — Import Sourcing Performance, Consolidation & Total-Landed-Cost Analytics (PA-122.3).)
- operational: packing-list control and origin inspection; operational: consolidation scheduling and vendor performance (links to W3805)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Consolidation-error risk**: Wrong vendor/category in container; mitigated by packing-list control and origin inspection
- **Origin-delay risk**: Late vendor delays whole container; mitigated by consolidation scheduling and vendor performance (links to W3805)
System Touchpoints: - Freight (links to VS-110); customs (links to VS-87); quality (links to VS-31); DC receiving (links to VS-04); import ops (links to VS-02.2)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/Agent/Office execute origin consolidation: coordinate multi-vendor/multi-category POs to a consolidation point (CFS/warehouse), consolidate into FCL where economic or ship LCL, and manage origin documentation/packing/list (links to VS-87)
Global Sourcing/Quality run origin pre-shipment inspection of consolidated loads (links to W1613/W3798) so defective goods are caught before ocean transit

Global Sourcing/Freight/Customs manage consolidated-container documentation and handoff to carrier/broker (links to VS-02.2/VS-87/VS-110), and reconcile multi-vendor contents at receiving (links to VS-04)

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Freight (links to VS-110), Supply Planning (links to VS-02), Logistics Finance (links to W3788), Customs (links to VS-87), Treasury (links to VS-18)
fields.Trigger: Sourcing plan (W3785); freight contract cycle (links to VS-110)

workflows.name: Freight & Route Optimization for Import Sourcing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-route of "Global Sourcing/Freight optimize import freight routing" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-import of "Global Sourcing/Freight manage freight-cost components and surcharges" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-597 (ensure controlled execution — Import Sourcing Performance, Consolidation & Total-Landed-Cost Analytics (PA-122.3).)
- operational: route optimization and lane benchmarking; operational: documentation/delivery discipline (links to VS-02)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Suboptimal-routing risk**: Higher cost/slower route chosen; mitigated by route optimization and lane benchmarking
- **Demurrage risk**: Container stuck at port incurs demurrage; mitigated by documentation/delivery discipline (links to VS-02.2)
System Touchpoints: - Freight procurement (links to VS-110); import ops/demurrage (links to VS-02.2); finance (links to VS-17.4); customs (links to VS-87); treasury (links to VS-18)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/Freight optimize import freight routing: carrier/route/port selection (origin port → PH port), FCL vs LCL, transshipment vs direct, and final-leg to DC, in coordination with the freight-procurement program (links to VS-110.1) and landed-cost framework (links to W3788)

Global Sourcing/Freight manage freight-cost components and surcharges (BAF/CAF, low-sulfur, congestion, demurrage/detention links to VS-02.2/W249), and negotiate carrier contracts for import lanes (links to VS-110.1)
Global Sourcing/Finance publish import-freight cost analytics (cost/TEU, cost/cbm, lane benchmark, demurrage exposure) and recommend routing/carrier optimization (links to W3807/VS-110)

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Supply Planning (links to VS-02), Merchandising (links to VS-01), DC Ops (links to VS-04), Quality (links to VS-31), Freight (links to VS-110)

workflows.name: Import Sourcing Cycle-Time, Lead-Time & Flow Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Global Sourcing/Supply-Planning manage import sourcing cycle time and lead" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "tracking, milestone monitoring, exception management, and DC receiving…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report lead-time performance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-597 (ensure controlled execution — Import Sourcing Performance, Consolidation & Total-Landed-Cost Analytics (PA-122.3).)
- operational: lead-time management; operational: milestone tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Lead-time-variability risk**: Long/variable import lead time inflates safety stock; mitigated by lead-time management
- **Flow-disruption risk**: Bottleneck at any milestone delays receipt; mitigated by milestone tracking
System Touchpoints: - Demand planning (links to VS-02.1); import ops/in-transit (links to VS-02.2); freight visibility (links to VS-110.2); DC (links to VS-04); quality (links to VS-31)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/Supply-Planning manage import sourcing cycle time and lead time: order-to-receipt lead time by vendor/country/route (PO → production → origin consolidation → ocean → customs → DC), set planning lead times in the system (links to VS-02.1), and identify lead-time reduction opportunities
Global Sourcing manage in-transit visibility and flow (links to VS-02.2/VS-110.2): container tracking, milestone monitoring, exception management, and DC receiving synchronization
Global Sourcing/Supply-Planning translate lead-time insights into safety-stock, reorder-point, and demand-planning adjustments (links to VS-02.1) and report lead-time performance (links to W3805)

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Vendor Scorecard (links to VS-67), Quality (links to VS-31), Supply Planning (links to VS-02), Customs (links to VS-87), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Compliance (links to VS-22)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "document/ASN accuracy, compliance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "Global Sourcing produce import-vendor scorecards and ratings, conduct vendor" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-import of "Global Sourcing publish import-vendor analytics" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-597 (ensure controlled execution — Import Sourcing Performance, Consolidation & Total-Landed-Cost Analytics (PA-122.3).)
- operational: import-specific scorecard; operational: integration into sourcing
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hidden-poor-performer risk**: Weak import vendor not visible; mitigated by import-specific scorecard
- **Scorecard-disconnect risk**: Performance not influencing sourcing decisions; mitigated by integration into sourcing
System Touchpoints: - Vendor scorecard (links to VS-67); quality (links to VS-31); supply planning (links to VS-02); customs (links to VS-87); certification (links to VS-117); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/Vendor-Scorecard define and maintain import-vendor KPIs (extending VS-67.1 to import context): on-time delivery (origin/on-board and receipt), fill-rate, quality/defect rate (links to VS-31), lead-time variability, document/ASN accuracy, compliance (links to VS-87/VS-117), and social-compliance audit result (links to W3798)

Global Sourcing produce import-vendor scorecards and ratings, conduct vendor business reviews, and integrate import performance into the enterprise vendor-scorecard (links to VS-67) and sourcing decisions (links to W3785)
Global Sourcing publish import-vendor analytics (top/bottom performers, risk vendors, concentration) to governance (links to W3808/VS-67.3) and drive development/consolidation/corrective action

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Finance (links to VS-17.4), Procurement (links to VS-34), Quality (links to VS-31), ABC (links to VS-86.3), Compliance (links to VS-22), Analytics (links to VS-28.1)

workflows.name: Sourcing Agent / Overseas-Office Performance & Value Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-post of "Global Sourcing/Finance measure sourcing-agent and overseas-office value" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-renew of "Global Sourcing publish agent/office value analytics to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-597 (ensure controlled execution — Import Sourcing Performance, Consolidation & Total-Landed-Cost Analytics (PA-122.3).)
- operational: value analytics; operational: reconciliation and audit (links to W3800)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Value-opacity risk**: Agent/office value not measurable; mitigated by value analytics
- **Fee-leakage risk**: Agent fees/commissions unverified; mitigated by reconciliation and audit (links to W3800)
System Touchpoints: - Finance (links to VS-17.4); procurement (links to VS-34); ABC (links to VS-86.3); quality (links to VS-31); analytics (links to VS-28.1); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/Finance measure sourcing-agent and overseas-office value: delivered savings, vendor-base quality, on-time/quality, fee/commission vs value, control/compliance, and ABC posture (links to W3793/W3794/VS-86.3)
Global Sourcing compare agent/office vs direct-buying economics (savings, overhead, control, risk) per the sourcing-model framework (links to W3787), and recommend model migration
Global Sourcing publish agent/office value analytics to governance (links to W3808), manage fee reconciliation and renewal/replacement decisions

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Logistics Finance (links to VS-17.4/VS-106), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Freight (links to VS-110), Customs (links to VS-87), Treasury (links to VS-18), Merchandise Finance (links to VS-101)

workflows.name: Total-Landed-Cost Variance, Savings Realization & Margin Linkage

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics-Finance track total-landed-cost" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-import of "Global Sourcing/Finance measure realized import savings" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-597 (ensure controlled execution — Import Sourcing Performance, Consolidation & Total-Landed-Cost Analytics (PA-122.3).)
- operational: variance tracking; operational: realized-savings tracking and margin linkage
Pain Points / Risks: - **Variance-blindness risk**: TLC drifts without detection; mitigated by variance tracking
- **Savings-leakage risk**: Negotiated savings absorbed before reaching margin; mitigated by realized-savings tracking and margin linkage
System Touchpoints: - Finance/costing (links to VS-17.4); commodity (links to VS-106); freight (links to VS-110); customs (links to VS-87); treasury (links to VS-18); merchandise finance (links to VS-101); pricing (links to VS-01.2)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/Logistics-Finance track total-landed-cost (TLC) variance: actual vs planned FOB, freight, duty, brokerage, financing, shrink per SKU/source/route (links to W3788), identify variance drivers, and feed corrective action

Global Sourcing/Finance measure realized import savings (negotiated FOB savings, consolidation savings, freight optimization, duty/PTA savings) vs target and confirm flow-through to margin/retail (links to VS-101/W3796), preventing "negotiated but not realized" leakage
Global Sourcing/Merchandising link TLC to category margin and pricing decisions (links to VS-01.2/VS-101), ensuring import sourcing supports the 28–32% gross-margin and 6–8x turn targets

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, VP Merchandising, Finance (links to VS-17.4), Strategy (links to VS-33), Risk (links to VS-21.2), Compliance (links to VS-22/VS-87), ESG (links to VS-25), Analytics (links to VS-28.1), Executive (links to VS-36)
fields.Trigger: Executive cycle (links to VS-33.2); board reporting (links to VS-36)

workflows.name: Global Sourcing Executive Review & Strategic Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "Global Sourcing/VP-Merchandising compile the global-sourcing strategic review" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-post of "posture and risks to the executive committee and board" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-597 (ensure controlled execution — Import Sourcing Performance, Consolidation & Total-Landed-Cost Analytics (PA-122.3).)
- operational: strategic review and linkage; operational: board reporting
Pain Points / Risks: - **Strategic-disconnect risk**: Sourcing decisions not aligned to corporate strategy; mitigated by strategic review and linkage
- **Board-blindness risk**: Import sourcing risk not visible to the board; mitigated by board reporting
System Touchpoints: - Strategy (links to VS-33); risk (links to VS-21.2); finance (links to VS-17.4); ESG (links to VS-25); compliance/customs (links to VS-87); governance/board (links to VS-36); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/VP-Merchandising compile the global-sourcing strategic review: import mix and spend, TLC trend and savings realized (links to W3807), vendor/agent/office performance (links to W3805/W3806), source-market and risk posture (links to W3786/W3790), compliance and ESG posture (links to W3798/W3792), and model-portfolio economics

VP Merchandising/Strategy translate review into strategic sourcing decisions: source-market shifts, model migrations, vendor consolidation/development, and investment in agent/office capability — aligned to corporate strategy (links to VS-33) and merchandise plan (links to VS-101)

VP Merchandising report global-sourcing posture and risks to the executive committee and board (links to VS-36/VS-33.2), including supply-base geographic risk and resilience (links to W3790) and ESG/responsible-sourcing (links to VS-25)
